notes.cap: HEZE that can ever be issued across every deck; a unit of account inside the files, never a token
notes.awayHours: the most time a deck will catch up on when you come back
notes.secondsPerDay: how long a day is, in real seconds
notes.guildStaff: citizens a guild needs to run at full
notes.grainPerCitizen: grain in the village's store that feeds one citizen
notes.keepDefault: share of dues kept with no road built

text: The rulebook of the town. Keep a changed copy in the browser through the editor in the quarter and the town plays by it on its next load; write it into the yard and it plays by it for good.
